note: Words the gear prompts use (M13). Read by src/systems/items/gear_controller.gd. %s is an item or vendor label, %d a price or a credit balance. Kept here so code stays name-free.

backpack.full: Your backpack is full (%d of %d slots).
backpack.note: The player's backpack (Inventory.slots_used). The pistol always holds the first slot; each other kind of item you own takes one (a stack is one slot): the rifle, a saber, food, quartz, every contraband good. The jetpack and the armour take one too, but not while they are activated (worn: listed as '(activated)'). Picking up, buying, trading, unloading a cargo droid and taking gear off all need a free slot.

labels.attached: %s attached.  Hold Space in the air to fly.  [G] takes it off
labels.recovered: You drifted out over the walls. Back in port.
labels.no_room_to_take_off: No free slot in your backpack to put the %s in.
